decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor is a new, distinct sensor module with its own page and uncertain but promising demand, and keeping it in a modular catalogue costs little, so the option should stay open.
As the explicit successor of the Analog In Bricklet 2.0, it is now the firm's main voltage measurement module and has just received further commitment rather than abandonment.
The MQTT proxy is a cheap software option, but it could be superseded by native MQTT bindings, so it faces real abandonment risk, though the evidence does not yet justify dropping it.
A CAN bus interface serves a stable industrial niche and is cheap to keep listed while its value resolves.
The CO2 sensor has its own page and fits a growing air-quality market, so it stays in the portfolio, with some risk of later replacement by a revised version.
The touch panel accessory has an uncertain market but low holding cost and is showcased on its own page, so keeping the option is preferable to early abandonment.
